privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject used as a job queue for game sync requests

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of game IDs currently being processed to prevent duplicate jobs

privateVars.name: gameRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to upsert game records after syncing

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: Initializes the queue processing pipeline on module startup

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds a game ID to the sync queue if it is not already being processed

functions.name: getApiKey
functions.description: Retrieves the RAWG_API_KEY from environment variables

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Subscribes to the job queue with concurrent processing (max 3) and processes game sync jobs

functions.name: syncGameFromRawg
functions.description: Fetches game data from RAWG and upserts the record in the repository

functions.name: fetchFromRawg
functions.description: Fetches detailed game data from RAWG API for queue sync, returns null on failure
